title: GitHub Data Fetcher
description: A modular Rust CLI that interfaces with the GitHub REST API to retrieve repository and issue metadata, built with SOLID principles, object-oriented design, and asynchronous programming.
highlights: Cached structured JSON in Redis, reducing API calls by 80% and improving query efficiency
Robust async error handling in a modular, testable architecture

title: Data Blog
description: End-to-end data analyses on public datasets (sleep, income, health) with 10K–100K records, published as a live blog.
highlights: Regression and clustering models achieving up to 85% predictive accuracy
Full workflow: cleaning, EDA, model selection, and visualization with Pandas, Seaborn, and Tableau

title: Top Garden Landscaping & Design
description: A 5-page responsive client website built with React and Tailwind CSS, deployed on Vercel for a local landscaping business.
highlights: Increased client visibility and customer inquiries by 40% within 3 months through SEO and responsive design
Led weekly design iterations with client stakeholders, reducing revision time by 25%
